I am 57 years old and I never went to school. My mother and father taught me everything I know about farming this land. This barley plot is very small, only 0.17 hectares, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer — one bag costs too much money and is more than this little piece of land needs. I will spread cow dung from my animals instead because it costs nothing, and I will plant the barley seed I kept from last year's harvest. I do not use chemicals or water on barley — I wait for the rains and pull weeds with my hands. My family will work about fifteen days on this plot over the season, and I will not hire any workers because the plot is too small to waste cash on labor.
